```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import yaml
from utils.helpers import load_processed_data

with open("_params.yml") as f:
    params = yaml.safe_load(f)

has_reference = params["has_reference"]

if not has_reference:
    print("No scRNA-seq reference provided. This section is skipped.")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
if has_reference:
    import anndata as ad
    import segtraq

    st_dict = load_processed_data(params)

    # Load reference
    adata_ref = ad.read_h5ad(params["reference_path"])

    # Label transfer
    for method, st in st_dict.items():
        st.run_label_transfer(
            adata_ref,
            ref_cell_type=params["cell_type_key"],
            inplace=True,
        )
        print(f"{method}: label transfer done")
```

## Cell type distribution

```{python}
#| echo: false
if has_reference:
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    method_dfs = []
    for method, st in st_dict.items():
        df = (
            st.sdata["table"].obs["transferred_cell_type"]
            .value_counts(normalize=True)
            .reset_index()
        )
        df.columns = ["celltype", "proportion"]
        df["method"] = method
        method_dfs.append(df)

    plot_df = pd.concat(method_dfs, ignore_index=True)
    plot_wide = plot_df.pivot(
        index="method", columns="celltype", values="proportion"
    ).fillna(0)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 5))
    plot_wide.plot(kind="bar", stacked=True, ax=ax)
    ax.set_ylabel("Proportion")
    ax.set_xlabel("Method")
    ax.legend(title="Cell type", bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc="upper left", frameon=False)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("Section skipped — no reference provided.")
```

## Silhouette score on transferred labels

```{python}
#| echo: false
if has_reference:
    rows = []
    for method, st in st_dict.items():
        sil = st.cs.silhouette_score(cell_type_key="transferred_cell_type")
        rows.append({"Method": method, "Silhouette score (↑)": round(sil, 3)})

    pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Method")
else:
    print("Section skipped — no reference provided.")
```

## Supervised markers

```{python}
#| echo: false
if has_reference:
    markers = {}
    for method, st in st_dict.items():
        tbl = st.sdata["table"]
        common_genes = tbl.var_names[tbl.var_names.isin(adata_ref.var_names)]
        adata_ref_common = adata_ref[:, common_genes].copy()

        markers[method] = segtraq.markers_from_reference(
            adata_ref_common,
            cell_type_key=params["cell_type_key"],
            n_jobs=-1,
        )
        print(f"{method}: markers computed")
else:
    print("Section skipped — no reference provided.")
```
